critical_code_review_comments: DEFAULT_PLANS dict uses uuid.uuid4() at module import time so every backend restart regenerates the plan_id — harmless because seed only inserts if collection empty, but worth noting. Consider using fixed slugs as the stable identifier (which is already done in practice).

PATCH /api/admin/plans uses PlanIn which requires all fields; partial updates not supported. OK for current admin UI (full form submit) but a Patch-style schema with Optional[...] fields would be more RESTful.

AdminWordIn does not accept audio field — that's intentional (audio is generated server-side via TTS script), but admin-created words will have audio=null unless the TTS script is rerun. Consider documenting this or auto-triggering TTS on creation.
server.py is 1611 lines — approaching the 'should-split' threshold per code review guidelines; consider splitting into routers (words, admin, auth, billing, etc.) in a future iteration.
